seo.title: Isôoko Community Development — Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko n'Abakobwa i Masoro, u Rwanda
seo.description: Isôoko Community Development (ICD) ikorera abaturage b'i Masoro, u Rwanda, igamije guteza imbere urubyiruko n'abakobwa binyuze mu burezi, ubuzima bwiza, ubucuruzi, siporo n'ikoranabuhanga.

hero.title: Twiteza Imbere Twese, Abaturage b'i Masoro
hero.subtitle: Guteza Imbere Abakobwa · Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko · Siporo n'Ubuzima Bwiza · Ikoranabuhanga n'Uburezi

mission.title: Intego Yacu
mission.body: Dufasha abakobwa n'urubyiruko kubona amahirwe yo kwiteza imbere mu buryo burambye, binyuze mu buzima bwiza, uburezi, n'ubucuruzi. Ikigo cyacu cy'abaturage giherereye i Masoro gifite ibibuga bya siporo, laboratwari ya mudasobwa, isomero, ndetse n'ibiro bikoreshwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye by'uburezi n'iterambere ry'ubukungu.

programs.title: Porogaramu Zacu
programs.subtitle: Porogaramu eshanu zigamije kugirira akamaro abaturage

news.title: Amakuru Mashya
news.subtitle: Inkuru n'ibikorwa biba mu baturage ba Isôoko

cta.title: Fatanya Natwe Guteza Imbere Masoro
cta.text: Inkunga yawe ifasha abakobwa kwihangira imirimo, ifasha urubyiruko kubona ubumenyi bukenewe, kandi igafasha imiryango kwiteza imbere.
